start.title: [TODO:fr] A Joyful Feast
start.text:
[TODO:fr] Lanterns sway. Laughter rises.
The bride and groom dance.

slip_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Return
slip_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The feast still calls you.
Go back.

shortage.title: [TODO:fr] The Last Cup
shortage.text:
[TODO:fr] Whispers spread: the wine is gone.
Mary's eyes find her son.

pretend_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Speak
pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The guests will notice.
Do not pretend.

mother.title: [TODO:fr] His Mother's Voice
mother.text:
[TODO:fr] "They have no more wine," she says.
Then turns to you.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Trust Her Words
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] She has already spoken.
Obey her son.

instruct.title: [TODO:fr] A Quiet Command
instruct.text:
[TODO:fr] Jesus points to six stone jars.
"Fill them with water."

fill.text:
[TODO:fr] Six jars, full of cool water.
"Now draw some out," he says.

taste.title: [TODO:fr] The First Sip
taste.text:
[TODO:fr] The steward's eyes widen.
"You saved the best for last!"

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Be Still
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The wonder is his alone.
Give thanks.

slip2_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Stay. See what he has done.
Give thanks.

[TODO:fr] The disciples look at Jesus.
They believe.
